metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Rhomboid Muscle Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve rhomboid muscle tightness and pain.

Rhomboid pain is a common issue in the upper back, especially between the shoulder blades. This discomfort is often caused by tightness and weakness in the rhomboids and surrounding shoulder blade muscles.

In this video, you’ll learn exercises designed to lengthen and strengthen the rhomboids for both quick and long-lasting relief. For best results, make sure to go through all the exercises and use the ones that provide the most relief.

Best of all, these exercises can be done at home and may provide pain relief in as little as 30 seconds.

Watch now to quickly relieve rhomboid muscle pain!
